title: FARR: Forecast-Aware Residual Refinement with Matched Endpoint Evidence for Long-Horizon Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.07870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models use auxiliary conditioning to incorporate additional information into time-series forecasts. However, auxiliary conditioning does not consistently improve accuracy and can increase forecasting error when its influence is poorly matched to the observed temporal context. We propose Forecast-Aware Residual Refinement (FARR), which learns to correct forecasts using endpoint evidence. FARR obtains a valid forecast under the standard condition and a null forecast under a predefined null condition. Their difference reveals how conditioning changes the prediction. A shared residual refiner combines this endpoint evidence with historical features to estimate the remaining error of the valid forecast. Horizon-wise gating then controls the contribution of the predicted residual to the final output. translated_title: FARR：基于匹配端点证据的预测感知残差精炼方法用于长时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型使用辅助条件机制将额外信息融入时间序列预测中。然而，辅助条件并不能持续提升预测精度，当其影响与观测到的时间上下文匹配不佳时，反而可能增加预测误差。我们提出了预测感知残差精炼方法（FARR），它学习利用端点证据来校正预测。FARR 在标准条件下获得一个有效预测，并在预定义的空条件下获得一个空预测，二者的差异揭示了条件化如何改变预测结果。一个共享的残差精炼器将这一端点证据与历史特征相结合，以估计有效预测的剩余误差。随后，逐视界门控机制控制预测残差对最终输出的贡献。在四个长时间序列预测基准上的实验表明，FARR 在所比较的方法中取得了最佳的跨数据集平均 MSE 和 MAE。
tldr: 提出 FARR 方法，通过对比标准条件与空条件下的预测差异获得端点证据，并利用共享残差精炼器结合逐视界门控机制来校正预测残差，在四个长期时序预测基准上取得了最优的平均 MSE 和 MAE。
